The final answer key and detailed rationales remain withheld until you release them for a completed attempt.</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn teal" id="release-visible" ${done.length?'':'disabled'}>Release for completed students</button><button class="btn secondary" id="revoke-visible" ${done.length?'':'disabled'}>Revoke for completed students</button></div><p class="legend-line">Applies to completed students in the current filters. Use each student’s <strong>Export control</strong> button for other devices; they import that file in their completed dashboard. A revoke takes effect there when its newer control arrives.</p></section>`;
}
function bindKeyControls(){
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-key-action]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{try{const r=records.find(x=>x.attemptId===b.dataset.attempt);const action=b.dataset.keyAction;issueKeyControl(r,action);render();toast(action==='release'?'Final key released for this completed attempt. Export its control file when the student uses another device.':'Final key revoked for this attempt. Send the newer control file to students using another device.')}catch(e){toast(e.message,true)}});
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-export-control]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const r=records.find(x=>x.attemptId===b.dataset.exportControl),p=r&&controlFor(r);if(!p)return;download(`Key_${p.action}_${fname(r.identity.erp)}_${r.attemptId.slice(0,8)}.json`,p);toast(`Latest ${p.action} control exported. It applies only to this student’s completed attempt.`)});
 for(const [id,action]of[['release-visible','release'],['revoke-visible','revoke']])if($('#'+id))$('#'+id).onclick=()=>{try{const rows=paired();rows.forEach(r=>issueKeyControl(r,action));render();toast(`${rows.length} completed attempt(s): final key ${action==='release'?'released':'revoked'}. Export individual controls for other devices.`)}catch(e){toast(e.message,true)}};
}
function receiveClassroomRecord(r,refresh=true){
 try{const result=mergeRecord(r);if(result==='Duplicate ignored')return false;save();if(refresh)render();return true}catch(e){toast('Incoming response was rejected: '+e.message,true);return false}
}
function pickUpCompletedRecords(refresh=true){
 let changed=false;
 try{const map=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(COMPLETED_STORE)||'{}');if(map&&typeof map==='object'&&!Array.isArray(map)){for(const r of Object.values(map)){try{validateRecord(r);if(completed(r))changed=receiveClassroomRecord(r,false)||changed}catch(e){}}}}catch(e){}
 if(changed&&refresh)render();
}
function connectClassroom(){
 keyControls=readKeyControls();
 try{classroomChannel=new BroadcastChannel(CLASSROOM_CHANNEL);classroomChannel.onmessage=e=>{const m=e.data;if(!m||typeof m!=='object')return;if(m.type==='response')receiveClassroomRecord(m.record);if(m.type==='hello'&&isText(m.attemptId,100)){const p=keyControls[m.attemptId];if(validControlPacket(p))broadcast({type:'key-control',packet:p})}}}catch(e){classroomChannel=null}
 window.addEventListener('storage',e=>{if(e.key===COMPLETED_STORE)pickUpCompletedRecords();if(e.key===CONTROL_STORE){keyControls=readKeyControls();render()}});
 pickUpCompletedRecords(false);
}
connectClassroom();

render();
</script></body></html>
